title: UbiEnlight: User-Perception-Aware Real-Time Low-Light Video Enhancement on Mobile Devices and Smartglasses
abstract: arXiv:2611.28085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-light video capture is now common on smartphones and wearables, yet dynamic illumination coupled with mobile/werable user motion causes noise, blur, and flicker that make videos hard to perceive and use, especially for users with night blindness and near-eye displays. Prior work enhances frames with post-hoc temporal constraints or optimizes videos directly; however,low-light and motion degradations are spatiotemporally coupled, so post-hoc consistency after per-frame restoration often leaves flicker and motion artifacts. We present UbiEnlight, the first diffusion-transformer-based on-device system for real-time, temporally stable low-light video enhancement. UbiEnlight builds on two insights: (1) illumination and structure separate more robustly in the frequency domain, enabling a spectrum-guided diffusion transformer that injects Fourier amplitude/phase priors to correct illumination while anchoring structure without optical flow

translated_title: UbiEnlight：面向用户感知的移动设备与智能眼镜实时低光照视频增强
translated_abstract: 低光照视频拍摄如今在智能手机和可穿戴设备上已十分普遍，然而动态光照变化与移动/可穿戴用户的运动相结合，会导致噪声、模糊和闪烁，使视频难以感知和使用，对于患有夜盲症的用户和近眼显示设备而言尤其如此。先前的工作通过事后时间约束来增强帧，或直接对视频进行优化；然而，低光照退化与运动退化在时空上是相互耦合的，因此逐帧恢复后再进行事后一致性处理往往会留下闪烁和运动伪影。我们提出了 UbiEnlight，这是首个基于扩散Transformer的端侧系统，可实现实时、时间稳定的低光照视频增强。UbiEnlight 建立在两个洞察之上：（1）光照与结构在频域中能够更稳健地分离，由此实现了频谱引导的扩散Transformer，通过注入傅里叶幅度/相位先验来校正光照，同时无需光流即可锚定结构
tldr: 提出了首个基于扩散Transformer的端侧实时低光照视频增强系统 UbiEnlight，利用频域中光照与结构分离更稳健的特性，通过频谱引导的扩散Transformer注入傅里叶幅度/相位先验，在无需光流的情况下实现移动设备与智能眼镜上实时且时间稳定的视频增强。
en_tdlr: UbiEnlight is the first diffusion-transformer-based on-device system for real-time, temporally stable low-light video enhancement on mobile devices and smartglasses, which leverages a spectrum-guided diffusion transformer that injects Fourier amplitude/phase priors to correct illumination while anchoring structure without optical flow.
